rubric.1: Knows what the task is and why it matters, cannot do it yet.
rubric.2: Does the task with guidance or step-by-step help.
rubric.3: Does the task correctly on their own.
rubric.4: Does it fluently and can coach peers.

admin.title: Competencies
admin.intro: Define what each course teaches: competencies with a required level, the assessments that evidence them, and the resources students are pointed to.
admin.caption: Competencies of this course
admin.evidenceHint: Assessments from this course's batches that show this competency.
admin.noAssessments: This course has no assessments yet.

resources.title: Resource library
resources.intro: Videos, readings, practice tasks and remedial sessions. Students see only approved resources.
resources.caption: Learning resources

trainer.title: Competencies
trainer.intro: Rate each student on the course competencies and verify skills they have mastered. The heatmap shows where the batch needs practice.

grid.caption: Competency ratings
grid.verifyHint: Verify only when the student has reached the required level.
grid.readOnly: Ratings can be changed by the batch's trainer while the batch is active.
grid.noCompetencies: This course has no competencies yet. Ask an administrator to define them.

gaps.title: My skill gaps
gaps.intro: How your skills compare with what the course requires, and what to practise next.
gaps.none: You will see your skills here once you are placed in a batch and the course has competencies.
gaps.belowEmpty: No gaps among the skills assessed so far.
gaps.notAssessedHint: Your trainer hasn't rated these yet and no linked assessment is recorded.
gaps.noRecommendations: No resources yet — ask your trainer.
